title: Sensitive Data Flow Map
purpose: Trace five categories of sensitive data (PII, secrets, auth tokens, payment data, AI data) across entry points, storage locations, and transmission channels, highlighting security and privacy risks.
audience: Security engineers, compliance team, data protection officers, backend developers
description: Five categories of sensitive data are traced. PII: entered via signup form (email, username), verification upload (ID, selfie), support tickets; stored in profiles table, support_tickets JSONB; transmitted via 60s signed URLs via R2, email via SMTP (unused), auth debug log to disk (27K+ lines via appendFileSync). Secrets/Credentials: entered via environment variables and .env files; stored in 3 .env copies (root, backend, frontend) and Render/Netlify env config; transmitted in frontend bundle if VITE_-prefixed. CRITICAL: JWT_SECRET and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in frontend .env expose server secrets to client. Auth Data: JWT entered via Supabase Auth response, stored in localStorage/sessionStorage, transmitted as Bearer header on every request. XSS vulnerable. Payment Data: crypto wallet address, tx hashes, USDC amounts stored in transactions table and subscriptions table; transmitted via Ethereum RPC. No raw card data stored (Stripe Elements tokenizes on frontend). AI Data: image uploads for captions stored as content descriptions; transmitted as base64 to OpenRouter/OpenAI without user consent.
preconditions: Platform is operational with users, payments, and AI features active
Sensitive data flows are functioning across all five categories
postconditions: All sensitive data entry, storage, and transmission paths are documented
Critical leaks (JWT_SECRET in frontend, PII in debug log, no AI consent) are identified

validationRules: PII must not be written to disk-based debug logs
JWT_SECRET must never be in frontend .env files
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must never be in frontend .env files
User consent must be obtained before sending media to third-party AI APIs
Raw card data must never be stored server-side (Stripe Elements compliance)
securityConsiderations: CRITICAL: JWT_SECRET in frontend .env exposes server signing key to all users
CRITICAL: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in frontend .env gives full DB access to client
CRITICAL: auth.middleware.ts writes PII to debug.log via synchronous appendFileSync (27K+ lines)
HIGH: localStorage JWT storage is XSS-vulnerable
HIGH: AI caption sends user media to third-party API without consent
OK: Payment card data is tokenized by Stripe Elements — no raw card data on backend
performanceConsiderations: auth.middleware.ts appendFileSync is synchronous IO — blocks event loop
Debug log at 27K+ lines indicates production debug overhead
